import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
let booted = false;
test('probe', () => { booted = existsSync('/run/systemd/system') && !!process.env.NEVER; });
let body = (t) => {};
for (body of [(t) => { if (!booted) { t.skip('not a booted host'); return; } }]);
test('acceptance: the engine unit starts', body);
